apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fineractdb-initdb
  labels:
    app: fineract-server
data:
  01-init.sh: |
    psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username postgres --dbname postgres <<-EOSQL      
      CREATE DATABASE fineract_tenants;
      CREATE DATABASE fineract_default;
      GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE fineract_tenants TO postgres;
      GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE fineract_default TO postgres;
      \c fineract_tenants
      GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO postgres;
      \c fineract_default
      GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO postgres;
    EOSQL

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: fineractdb-pv-volume
  labels:
    type: local
spec:
  storageClassName: manual
  capacity:
    storage: 10Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany
  hostPath:
    path: "/mnt/data"

---

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: fineractdb-pv-claim
spec:
  storageClassName: manual
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi

---

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app: fineract-server
  name: fineractdb
spec:
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
  selector:
    app: fineract-server
    tier: fineractdb
  clusterIP: None

---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: fineract-server
  name: fineractdb
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: fineract-server
      tier: fineractdb
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: fineract-server
        tier: fineractdb
    spec:
      containers:
        - image: postgres:17.5
          name: postgresql
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "1Gi"
              cpu: "1000m"
            limits:
              memory: "5Gi"
              cpu: "2000m"
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: fineract-tenants-db-secret
                  key: password
          #livenessProbe:
          #  exec:
          #    command: ["sh","-c","postgresqladmin ping -h localhost -uroot -p${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"]
          #  failureThreshold: 10
          #  timeoutSeconds: 10
          #readinessProbe:
          #  exec:
          #    command:
          #      - sh
          #      - -c
          #      - postgresqladmin ping -uroot -p${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
          #  failureThreshold: 10
          #  initialDelaySeconds: 5
          #  periodSeconds: 5
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
              name: fineractdb
          volumeMounts:
            - name: fineractdb-initdb
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/
            #- name: fineractdb-persistent-storage
            #  mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/
      volumes:
        - name: fineractdb-initdb
          configMap:
            name: fineractdb-initdb
        - name: fineractdb-persistent-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: fineractdb-pv-claim

param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Dump,
  [string]$Image = 'postgres:18.3@sha256:7e32e9833a6fb1c92c32552794cb6ed569d51b445a54907d35fc112ef39684db'
)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$name="channel-restore-drill-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8))"
$password="restore-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
docker run -d --name $name -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$password $Image | Out-Null
try {
  for($i=0;$i -lt 30;$i++){if((docker exec $name pg_isready -U postgres) -match 'accepting connections'){break};Start-Sleep 2}
  docker exec $name createdb -U postgres bank_channel | Out-Null
  docker exec $name createuser -U postgres bank_channel | Out-Null
  docker cp $Dump "${name}:/tmp/channel.dump"
  docker exec $name pg_restore --exit-on-error -U postgres -d bank_channel /tmp/channel.dump | Out-Null

  $tables=docker exec $name psql -U postgres -d bank_channel -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';"

  $invalidStatus=docker exec $name psql -U postgres -d bank_channel -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM transfer_order WHERE status NOT IN ('CREATED','VALIDATING','RISK_REVIEW','PENDING_APPROVAL','PENDING_CORE_POSTING','PENDING_CLEARING','SETTLED','FAILED','TIMED_OUT','RETURNED','REVERSAL_PENDING','REVERSED');"

  $auditHashMissing=docker exec $name psql -U postgres -d bank_channel -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM security_audit_event WHERE record_hash IS NULL OR record_hash='';"

  $orphanHistory=docker exec $name psql -U postgres -d bank_channel -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM transfer_state_history h LEFT JOIN transfer t ON t.transfer_id=h.transfer_id WHERE t.transfer_id IS NULL;"

  $dupIdempotency=docker exec $name psql -U postgres -d bank_channel -Atc "SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT scope_key) FROM idempotency_record;"

databaseChangeLog:
  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p3-1-rename-transfer-to-transfer-order
      author: BankingDomainAgent
      changes:
        - renameTable:
            oldTableName: transfer
            newTableName: transfer_order
      comment: v4 §8.1 requires table name transfer_order

  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p3-2-add-v4-columns
      author: BankingDomainAgent
      changes:
        - addColumn:
            tableName: transfer_order
            columns:
              - column:
                  name: tenant_id
                  type: varchar(64)
                  defaultValue: 'default'
                  constraints:
                    nullable: false
              - column:
                  name: source_fineract_id
                  type: varchar(64)
              - column:
                  name: destination_type
                  type: varchar(32)
                  defaultValue: 'ACCOUNT'
                  constraints:
                    nullable: false
              - column:
                  name: destination_ref
                  type: varchar(64)
              - column:
                  name: fineract_transfer_id
                  type: bigint
              - column:
                  name: clearing_reference
                  type: varchar(128)
              - column:
                  name: failure_code
                  type: varchar(64)
              - column:
                  name: failure_detail
                  type: varchar(512)
      comment: v4 §8.1 required columns missing from transfer table
